_comment: Rubric for the one LLM-judged golden task (G12), plus four calibration replies. Run the calibration first: a judge you have not tested is not a grader. Two replies should score high and two low. All content is fictional.

empathetic_delay_reply.task_prompt: Write a short, empathetic reply to the customer on order BW-1007, whose order is delayed. Include the new arrival date.
criteria: Acknowledges the delay and the inconvenience in plain language, without excessive apology
States the new arrival date and the reason (weather hold at the regional hub) accurately
Offers a next step or a way to get help
Is brief (under 120 words), professional and free of invented facts such as compensation or discounts

calibration.reply: Hi Priya, I am sorry your order BW-1007 is running late. A weather hold at the regional hub is delaying the Parcelry shipment, and it is now expected on 2026-10-27. If the new date does not work for you, reply here and we will go over your options.

Hello Priya, thank you for your patience. Order BW-1007 was held at a regional hub because of weather and should now arrive by October 27. I know that is later than planned. Reply to this message if you would like help with anything else on the order.
Order BW-1007 is delayed. It will arrive 2026-10-27.
We are so, so sorry!!! Because of this terrible failure we are giving you a 50 percent refund and a free tent. Your order will arrive tomorrow, guaranteed.
